extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from local XML/PDF, figure captions/images, BLI section, and supplementary docking/BLI figures.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TLH and VFI act at an early extracellular/entry-stage step for SARS-CoV-2 because co-treatment and virus pre-treatment inhibit infection while cell pre-treatment and post-treatment are not significant.
direct_assay_types: plaque reduction assay with treatment-timing design
mechanism_claims.limitations: Treatment-timing assays localize activity to virus/entry-stage conditions but do not prove a single molecular blocking event by themselves.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: VFI, but not TLH, shows source-supported HCoV-OC43 antiviral activity in co-treatment and virus pre-treatment; the paper connects this selectivity to VFI docking at an exposed HCoV-OC43 spike site.
direct_assay_types: plaque reduction assay with treatment-timing design
mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking is supporting model evidence; final conclusion remains bounded to source-observed antiviral timing/selectivity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BLI directly supports interaction of both peptides with SARS-CoV-2 RBD, with apparent micromolar affinity values reported for VFI and TLH.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TLH and VFI with SARS-CoV-2 RBD

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=17:3.6. Direct Binding Assays between Tripeptides and SARS-CoV-2 Spike Protein

mechanism_claims.limitations: BLI uses isolated RBD and does not alone establish whole-virus efficacy; it corroborates the source-authored RBD-binding mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular docking predicts TLH and VFI can occupy SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD/S2 regions and HCoV-OC43 spike regions, but these predictions are not promoted above computational support.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking scores and modeled contacts are recorded as computational mechanism context, not direct mechanism proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Serum stability is source-supported: TLH half-life is 4.36 h and VFI preserves 50% integrity after 12.44 h in 50% human serum.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=18:3.7. Stability of Tripeptides in Human Serum

mechanism_claims.limitations: Serum stability supports developability context and is not an antimicrobial/antiviral potency endpoint.
